description: Register a Custom Epistemic Connector (live REST API webhook, SQL/JSON table snapshot, data-retrieval sub-agent endpoint, or MCP tool bridge) on a Small World (@domain:tag).

endpoint_url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint URL for live retrieval.

name.description: Human-readable connector name (e.g. 'Acme ERP SLA API').

response_axioms_path.description: Optional dot-path into the JSON response (e.g. 'data.rows').

row_template.description: Optional Python format string to render dict rows into declarative axioms.

static_rows.description: Optional inline SQL/JSON table rows when connector_type is 'sql_table_snapshot'.

world_id_or_handle.description: Target Small World handle (e.g. '@law:contract-act') or UUID.

name: syntropy_register_connector
